title: Your hands
subtitle: Why the program looks the way it does

body.text: Your grip will often tire before the muscle you're training does. That's not weakness — it's just where your RA sits. So the program routes around it:

items: Kettlebells at the chest rather than hanging from one hand
Ankle weights for single-leg work — no hands involved at all
A band alternative on every pull and press
Planks on forearms, push-ups on a raised surface

body.text: On days your hands are sore, take the easier option and log it. That's the app working as intended, not a missed session.
